newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key TIFFE 3-mth Euroyen futures fall 0.1 to 99.10.
newsitem.headline: Key TIFFE 3-mth Euroyen futures fall 0.1 to 99.10.

text.p: The key December three-month Euroyen deposit rate futures contract on TIFFE fell by 0.10 to 99.10 in late Tuesday afternoon trade.
The December contract fell quickly after breaking through a support point of 99.15 in the mid-afternoon, traders said.
Stop-loss selling was triggered as the contract fell below what were considered to be support points at 99.15, 99.14, 99.13 and then 99.12, they said.
As of 0620 GMT, the contract fell as low as 99.08.
